sellers.name: Wilson's Estate Jewelry
sellers.return_window: Contact within 7 calendar days of delivery; item must be back within 3 calendar days of receiving the return label
sellers.return_exclusions: Sold 'as is'; no refund if contacted late or returned late; items must be unworn, unaltered and in original packaging; cancelled-before-shipment orders are not refunded the 3% credit-card processing fee. sellers.resize_policy: Listings state whether a ring is 'sizable'; resizing is done by the buyer's jeweller, and items altered by a third party remain sold 'as is' outside the return window
sellers.payment_notes: Card processing fee of 3% is referenced for cancellations, confirming card payment is accepted; instalment plan shown on product pages. sellers.offers_xrf_or_assay: Not offered per item; 'Stamped for X karat' is the seller's statement. Some pieces are described as 'tested as' a karat
sellers.verification: Weight in grams, stamp description, maker's mark, phone and email verified verbatim on three individual official product pages on 2026-10-22. This is the only seller in the study that publishes gram weights. The international final-sale clause, the layaway terms and the returns-page wording were read verbatim on 2026-10-23 by arena/699d8e05-gold3 (pass P3); the 3% fee on this record is Wilson's own and is unaffected by the RET7 correction (F15).

sellers.name: Catbird
sellers.return_window: 20 days from the date the package was delivered (online, domestic shipments only); refunds go to the original form of payment or store credit, and processing can take up to 7-10 business days after the return is received
sellers.return_exclusions: Verbatim from the returns page: 'Special orders, engraved items, Forever jewelry, earrings from piercing events, home & beauty items, and comestibles are final sale and cannot be returned.' Also: items must be unused and in original packaging; all returns must be authorised by Catbird; an $9 return-shipping charge is deducted; Catbird 'reserve[s] the right to deny credit if the merchandise returned does not meet our return policy requirements' and cannot cover lost, stolen or missing packages; 'All international sales are final' with no refund of duties and taxes; jewelry sets ('Bundles') exchange for store credit only
sellers.resize_policy: Repairs and resizing are accepted only 'on jewelry bought from Catbird', through the sizing-and-repairs form (https://www.catbirdnyc.com/catbird-sizing-and-repairs); the lead time and cost are quoted after the item is received. Items resized or altered by anyone else fall outside the return terms
sellers.payment_notes: Card checkout and Klarna instalments confirmed on official site
sellers.price_display: Sale price shown against a regular price
sellers.verification: Returns page and contact page both re-fetched verbatim on 2026-10-23 by arena/699d8e05-gold3 (pass P3), correcting three values this same pass had drafted wrongly - the e-mail address, a return address that the site does not publish, and a final-sale list copied from data/retailers.json instead of from this page. Closes flag POL1 for this seller. Klarna instalments are offered alongside card checkout. The 20-day window and $9 fee on this record and on data/retailers.json 'catbird' agree.
